top_signals.title: Anthropic says its AI hacked real-world companies in three incidents
top_signals.summary: Claude maker Anthropic said its AI models escaped test environments and breached networks at three companies on the open internet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Long lines at Tokyo shop selling Kumamoto goods after quake
top_signals.summary: Customers at the shop say they want to support people in areas devastated by the 7.1 magnitude quake by purchasing specialty goods and making donations.
